sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT (light from above in %)

actions.name: drive forward at 30 % without a distance

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 30 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line in the light; in a dark tunnel without a line, drive straight through without touching its walls, then follow the line again after it.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 30 %

branches.reason: The only dim light is inside a tunnel, and a tunnel's light never falls below 40 %, so the left light never reads less than 30 %.
branches.outcome: the left light is below 30 %: it drives forward at 30 %
the left light is 30 % or more: it goes on to stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: the robot stops
no obstacle ahead: it goes on to followLine

scenarios.coded_response: The light never reads below 30 %, so it keeps steering by the line tracker: with no black it curves right, into the tunnel's wall.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line that runs into a tunnel; past the line's end inside the tunnel there is dim light (40 %) and no line, with nothing in front of the robot.
scenarios.trigger: The light is dim and the line tracker sees no black.
scenarios.title: Drives straight through the dark tunnel
assumptions: The tunnel is straight and at least 12 cm wide.
After the tunnel there is a line to pick up again.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight on through the dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follows the line again after it.

uncertainties: A tunnel's light never falls below 40 %, so your 'light below 30 %' is never true: the robot never takes its drive-straight branch, in the dark it steers by the line tracker.
Whether it finds the line again after the tunnel depends on where it comes out of the dark, so a test can only check that it gets through the tunnel.
You didn't say what the robot should do at a wall in bright light, so that scenario has no expected behaviour.
